note: Frontier open-weight catalog. Ordered by an intelligence index; the picker re-ranks by intelligence x what fits the target hardware. params_b is TOTAL parameters (the memory driver, incl. all MoE experts); active_b is what computes per token (the speed driver). Ollama tags are verified against the live library; hf_id is best-effort for the newest models and is corrected by Refresh. Refreshable via /models/refresh-catalog. Release 1 of the rebuilt catalogue (issue #304): every intelligence value is 0 (unscored, no sourced index) so the picker offers the largest model that fits; rows carry additive keys (licence, origin_region, size, fit, validation); 12 rows carry the explicit GGUF tag in gguf_tag (ollama_tag is unchanged; the app switches in a later release). See docs/specs/model-catalogue-release-1.md.
